en: Colorized vintage street view of a European town. Tall multi‑story buildings with shutters line both sides of a broad street where a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible. In the distance, on a hillside, a fortified complex or castle rises above the town. The caption at the top reads "ROVERETO – S. Maria," and on the left façade a sign reads "PICCOLO ROVAZZI."
